title: A great morning touring Barcelona by Segway
text: A great morning  touring round the city of Barcelona by Segway. We had Max as our guide who was excellent, helpful and informative. The tour was at a good pace with frequent stops  at places of interest- we really enjoyed it and would highly recommend.
